generalCriterionList.description: Tenders  from Joint ventures are not acceptable.

Bidders shall ensure upload of relevant document certifying his/her status as Scheduled Caste/ Scheduled Tribe/other reserved category as prescribed in the tender document.

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.

itemList.description: HT Yard Works VCB Panel - (Outdoor Type) Supply, installation, testing & commissioning of outdoor cubicle type 1 panel 11 kV, 50 HZ, AC RMU comprising of 1 no. 11kV, 21 kA, 630 A VCB for outgoing for transformer protection . as per EB/BESCOM requirement.

Transformer yard works TransformerSupply, erection, testing & commissioning of 1600KVA,11/0.433kV, ONAN, Copper Wound Oil Cooled Distribution Transformer Energy
Efficiency Level-2 (As per IS:1180 2021) with OLTC & RTCC Panel. with off circuit tap changer 5% to -15% in steps of 1.25% , plinth mounted type transformer as specified with cable box on both HT / LT side with all accessories as required for installation and properly grouted to the plinth with all accesories required for grouting. As per Latest BESCOM

LT Kiosk - (Outdoor Type) Supply, Installation, testing & commissioning of Pole mounted weather proof enclosure comprising of 2500A 4P ACB, suitable busbars for connecting cables, with provision for cable entry and terminations as per SLD. The panel will be Outdoor type suitalble for Pole mounting. this item includes all necessary hardwares for mounting the panel on the pole (Exclude the necessary Civil works).

LT Panels Design, fabrication, assembling, wiring, supply, installation, testing & commissioning of LT Panels fabricated out of 14 gauge CRCA sheet steel in a cubicle compartmentalized free standing floor/wall mounted, dust & vermin proof with reinforcement of suitable size angle iron channel and or flats wherever necessary. Panel shall be treated with all anti- corrosive process before painting as per specifications with 2 coats of zinc chromate primer & final approved shade of powder coated paint. 2 Nos of earthing terminals shall be provided for all the Distribution panels. Panels shall be suitable for 433 volts, 50Hz, 3 phase, 4 wire, supply system. Lifting hooks shall also be provided for all large panels. Approval of GA dwgs. shall be obtained from Consultants for each panel before fabrication. Main LT Panel for Stalls and Resturants as per SLD
